Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: public GitHub README diagram
Primary request: one wide marble tableau that shows a seven-step legal workflow as a readable flow, so a lawyer understands the order of work at a glance. The steps themselves are seven BLANK white-marble label plaques; localized text is added later outside the image, so no plaque may carry any letter, digit, glyph or mark.
Input images: Image 1 is the immutable Pantheon style reference; Image 2 is the required family-signature column.
Subject: Themis in white marble with a blindfold over her eyes, balanced scales in one hand and a lowered sword in the other, standing calmly at the left beside the classical column, watching the flow of work move away from her.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape. A classical white-marble column stands clearly at the left edge with Themis beside it. To the right of her, seven identical blank white-marble plaques lie on a warm ivory surface in a clear reading order: four plaques in an upper row left to right, then three plaques in a lower row left to right. Every plaque is a plain rectangle with a perfectly flat, smooth, empty face, gently raised above the surface with a soft shadow, all seven the same size and the same angle, seen straight on, none tilted in perspective, none overlapping, none touching the frame edge. Thin sky-blue threads connect plaque to plaque in that order with small blue arrowheads showing direction, the thread turning down at the end of the upper row and continuing into the lower row. A closed muted-gold folder rests just before the first plaque as the private client material entering the flow. Generous empty ivory space above and below the plaques.
Style/medium: premium restrained 3D product render, warm ivory Apple-like presentation, white marble, frosted glass, physically plausible materials, no illustration outlines
Lighting/mood: soft daylight from upper left, long gentle shadows, calm and confident
Color palette: ivory #F3EFE8, bright ivory #FBFAF6, white marble, sky blue #B8D6EA for the connecting threads and arrowheads, muted gold #C9A87A for the client folder only, charcoal #3E3A36
Constraints: preserve the reference style; preserve a recognizable classical column; Themis must wear the blindfold and hold balanced scales and a lowered sword; exactly seven plaques, four above and three below; every plaque face completely empty and flat enough to carry a caption later; highest final quality; maximum resolution
Avoid: dark background, black background, grey background, neon, purple gradient, smoky cinema lighting, heavy bronze, metallic or plastic marble, watermark, logo drift, owl, helmet, open eyes on Themis, engraved ornament on the plaque faces, tilted or perspective-distorted plaques, more or fewer than seven plaques
Text (verbatim): No readable text, no letters, no digits, no glyphs, no engraved marks on any surface.
